idea-plugin.name: 3D Visualizer
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.1.6 — Add Tools → Convert Depth Image to 3D for manual image conversion; automatic editor registration remains limited to 3D formats.

0.1.5 — Fix large-file transfer failures in the embedded browser and report which loading stage failed.

0.1.4 — Keep website welcome screens and examples out of IDE editors from startup.

0.1.3 — Deliver precise macOS scroll deltas directly to the viewer controls to avoid late zoom jumps in the embedded browser.

0.1.2 — Remove the upper IDE build limit so current and future IDE releases can load the plugin. Requires build 243 or newer and a JCEF-enabled runtime.

0.1.1 — Extend the IDE compatibility range through build 253 (2025.3).

0.1.0 — First standalone 3D preview for JetBrains IDEs: local point clouds, meshes and scan data, shared viewer controls, native download handling and isolated per-editor file delivery.

action.description: Open a depth image in 3D Visualizer and configure its projection
